title: ClockMark: Adaptive and Host-Dependent Watermarking for Large Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.27079v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Large language model (LLM) watermarking operates on the next-token distribution that evolves during generation. In streaming generation, each sampled token becomes part of the text and affects subsequent distributions. Embedding therefore proceeds with a changing host, unlike classical watermarking, which adapts embedding to an existing host signal. To accommodate this difference, we formulate a novel embedding framework for LLM watermarking based on two principles. We first argue that embedding should be adaptive, retaining the state of previous sampling decisions to better guide subsequent choices. We further argue that embedding should be host-dependent, using the current LLM distribution to constrain both token selection and state updates. translated_title: ClockMark：面向大语言模型的自适应与宿主相关水印技术
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）水印技术在生成过程中不断演化的下一词元分布上进行操作。在流式生成中，每个采样得到的词元都会成为文本的一部分，并影响后续的分布。因此，嵌入过程是在不断变化的宿主上进行的，这与经典水印技术不同——经典水印技术是将嵌入适配到已存在的宿主信号上。为了适应这一差异，我们基于两个原则为LLM水印构建了一种新颖的嵌入框架。我们首先论证嵌入应当是自适应的，即保留先前采样决策的状态，以更好地指导后续的选择。我们进一步论证嵌入应当是宿主相关的，即利用当前的LLM分布来同时约束词元的选择和状态的更新。基于这些原则，并遵循分布保持和抗文本编辑鲁棒性这两项要求，我们提出了ClockMark。它将自适应与宿主相关的嵌入与消息相结合……
tldr: 提出了ClockMark水印框架，首次基于“自适应嵌入”（保留先前采样决策状态）与“宿主相关嵌入”（利用当前LLM分布约束词元选择和状态更新）两大原则，在保持输出分布的同时实现对文本编辑的鲁棒水印嵌入。
en_tdlr: ClockMark is a novel LLM watermarking framework built on two principles—adaptive embedding that retains the state of previous sampling decisions, and host-dependent embedding that uses the current LLM distribution to constrain token selection and state updates—achieving distribution preservation and robustness against text editing.
